title: Vuse Pro One Device Kit
description:
The
Vuse Pro One Device Kit
is a ready-to-vape closed pod system. Pre-charged and pre-filled so you can start vaping straight out of the box. Features VapourBoost mode for denser clouds and a stronger hit.
Product Type:
Closed Pod System
Battery:
530mAh (Removable, Rechargeable)
Charging:
USB Type-C
Power Modes:
Base (5.5W) / VapourBoost (6.5W)
Activation:
Draw-Activated + VapourBoost Button
LED Indicator:
Battery Level, Power Mode, Lock Status
Device Lock:
Triple-Click to Lock/Unlock
E-Liquid Capacity:
2mL (1 Pod Included)
Pod Compatibility:
All Vuse Pods
Brand:
Vuse
Replacement pods sold separately. This kit includes one prefilled pod containing nicotine.
Available options: Clear - Flavour Free, Mint Ice, Polar Mint, Smooth Tobacco, Golden Tobacco Ice.
description_html:
The Vuse Pro One Device Kit is a ready-to-vape closed pod system. Pre-charged and pre-filled so you can start vaping straight out of the box. Features VapourBoost mode for denser clouds and a stronger hit.

  • Product Type: Closed Pod System
  • Battery: 530mAh (Removable, Rechargeable)
  • Charging: USB Type-C
  • Power Modes: Base (5.5W) / VapourBoost (6.5W)
  • Activation: Draw-Activated + VapourBoost Button
  • LED Indicator: Battery Level, Power Mode, Lock Status
  • Device Lock: Triple-Click to Lock/Unlock
  • E-Liquid Capacity: 2mL (1 Pod Included)
  • Pod Compatibility: All Vuse Pods
  • Brand: Vuse

Replacement pods sold separately. This kit includes one prefilled pod containing nicotine.

Available options: Clear - Flavour Free, Mint Ice, Polar Mint, Smooth Tobacco, Golden Tobacco Ice.
